headline: Does PPG’s Steady Earnings, Dividend Hike And Buybacks Reshape Its Capital Allocation Story (PPG)?
summary: PPG Industries, Inc. has reported past second quarter 2026 results showing sales of US$4,495 million versus US$4,195 million a year earlier, with net income easing to US$437 million and earnings per share broadly flat. Alongside reaffirming its full-year 2026 earnings guidance and increasing its quarterly dividend to US$0.74, PPG continued buybacks, completing US$956.61 million of repurchases since 2024. Now we’ll explore how reaffirmed full-year earnings guidance shapes PPG’s investment...
